analysis.summary: Management stated that FY25 marked a significant leap with broad-based growth in revenue, profits, and EPS, though net profit margins saw a marginal decline due to rising gold prices. April and May sales were slow due to high gold and silver prices and summer travel, but footfalls have since improved. The company opened a new 1,500 square feet showroom named KK Jewels Gold and Silver in Science City, Ahmedabad, with an investment of approximately INR33 crores to INR35 crores. Looking ahead, management expects a conservative revenue CAGR of 20% to 25% and is exploring opportunities in B2B and export markets. Kabra Jewels Limited reported broad-based growth in revenue, profits, and EPS for FY25, alongside the opening of a new showroom in May 2025.

demand_outlook.claim: The April and May sales were really very slow because of high gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So the April and May sales have been really very slow because of the high gold price, but now that people know that gold is not going to come down less than INR95,000.

demand_outlook.claim: Footfalls at the store have improved over the last one week due to upcoming weddings and accepted price levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Since the last one week, we are seeing good footfalls at the store because there are many weddings happening in August.

demand_outlook.claim: Sales of diamond jewellery decreased temporarily due to the impact of the lab-grown diamond market.
demand_outlook.quote: So, since this Jan, Feb, since this lab-grown market is very big, the sales of diamond jewellery has decreased for once.

demand_outlook.claim: The BKC diamond market reported a price hike of 7% to 8% in natural diamonds as demand shifted back.
demand_outlook.quote: And our diamond market, which is the BKC diamond market, has reported a price hike of 7% to 8% in the natural diamond because actually demand is going back to natural diamonds.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the sector is witnessing steady growth due to changing consumer preferences, increasing disposable incomes, and rising awareness of branded jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: With changing consumer preferences, increasing disposable incomes, and rising awareness of branded jewellery, the sector is witnessing steady growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened a new showroom called KK Jewels Gold and Silver in Science City, Ahmedabad in May 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The opening of a new showroom in May 2025, which is called KK Jewel's Gold and Silver is a key milestone in expanding its market presence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to open an exclusive silver boutique in Ahmedabad with an estimated investment of INR10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Already we have two silver stores. We want to come up with an exclusive silver boutique in a very nice area of Ahmadabad. The location hunt is going on. We have already shortlisted two places. We are talking to the owners. So that could be a store with an investment of INR10 crores, which could genuinely get us an additional sale of INR15 crores to INR20 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to enter the B2B and export markets.
capex_expansion.quote: Not only B2B market, we are also trying to enter into export market. And recently, we have taken a part in an exhibition at Saudi also, Saudi Arabia.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened a new showroom in May 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The opening of a new showroom in May 2025 is a key milestone in expanding its market presence.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit margins saw a marginal decline because increases in gold prices are not always entirely proportionate to selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: Despite a notable increase in gold price, the net profit margin saw a marginal decline as the increase in gold price cost is often not entirely proportionate to the increase in selling prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin dropped from 16% in November to 13% in March due to gold and silver price increases.
margins_costs.quote: So as a whole EBITDA if you see in November it was around 16% and in March it is around 13%. So that 3% effect basically is mainly because of gold price and silver price increase only.

margins_costs.claim: Finance cost as a part of turnover is around 5% for both 2024 and 2025.
margins_costs.quote: In 24 and as well as in 25 also, but with the increase in turnover and due to IPO fund which we have received now, we will not be increasing much debt. So, finance cost will go down in the near future.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit margins saw a marginal decline due to the increase in gold purchase costs not being entirely proportionate to the increase in selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: Despite a notable increase in gold prices, the net profit margins saw a marginal decline as the increase in gold purchase costs is often not entirely proportionate to the increase in selling prices.

margins_costs.claim: Labour charges rise along with overall revenue when gold prices increase.
margins_costs.quote: Additionally, while overall revenue rises with gold prices, the labour charges also rise.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates all retail locations on a lease model.
orders_capacity.quote: All retail locations are currently operated on a lease model.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is not planning to reduce any external debt currently, but may plan to reduce debt from accruals within two or three years.
capital_allocation.quote: So, as of now, the company is not planning to reduce any external debt as of now. But, obviously, in the near future we cannot assure you within how much time, but within two or three years, the company may plan to reduce the debt once the maximum number of stores are opened and thereafter, the company may plan to reduce the debt from the accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt reduced due to regular vehicle loan repayments and the full repayment of an NBFC loan of around INR9 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: And that one loan from NBFC which we had acquired earlier, that has been fully paid off of around INR9 crores. So, long-term debt has reduced mainly because of repayment of vehicle loan installments as well as repayment of this you can say, NBFC and inter corporate loan.

capital_allocation.claim: INR11.5 crores of the IPO funds remain unutilized.
capital_allocation.quote: And second thing, the IPO fund that has come, even today we have kept INR11.5 crores unutilized.

capital_allocation.claim: All retail locations are currently operated on a lease model.
capital_allocation.quote: All retail locations are currently operated on a lease model.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilized internal accruals as funds to meet working capital and operational capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: To meet the funds requirement of working / operational capital your Company utilize the internal accruals as funds.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the period under review to provide a cushion for future financial contingencies and strengthen the financial position.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to provide a cushion for any financial contingencies in the future and to strengthen the financial position of the Company, your directors have decided not to recommend any dividend for the period under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: A notable increase in gold and silver prices impacts profit margins and causes customer hesitation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite a notable increase in gold price, the net profit margin saw a marginal decline as the increase in gold price cost is often not entirely proportionate to the increase in selling prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged that volatility in gold and diamond prices impacts margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in gold and diamond prices impacting margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that exchange rate fluctuations affect exports.
Management highlighted that fluctuations in precious metal prices may impact profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fluctuations in precious metal prices may impact profitability.

management_commitments.quote: But, obviously, in the near future we cannot assure you within how much time, but within two or three years, the company may plan to reduce the debt once the maximum number of stores are opened and thereafter, the company may plan to reduce the debt from the accruals.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue investing in marketing efforts across traditional and digital platforms to enhance brand image and attract more enquiries and orders.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue investing in marketing efforts across traditional and digital platforms to enhance our brand image and attract more enquiries and orders.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to target millennial customers through social media platforms like Instagram.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to target millennial customers through social media platforms like Instagram by sharing visually appealing content.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Anand Chandubhai Thakkar was appointed as an Executive Director for a term of five years beginning from March 8, 2025, and ending on March 7, 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Mr. Anand Chandubhai Thakkar (DIN: 10975276), who was appointed as an Additional Director in the capacity of Executive Director of the Company with a monthly remuneration of Rs.2.5 lakh per month excluding perquisite, with effect from 08th March, 2025, and who satisfies the conditions for appointment under the Act and LODR, be and is hereby appointed as an Executive Director of the Company, for a term of five (5) years beginning from 08th March, 2025 and ending on 07th March, 2030 (both days inclusive).

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
